acceptance: The indexed recognizer returns exactly the matches of a reference full scan over 200 seeded random cases and the six fixture snapshots, and reports candidates examined and index memory.

positive.fixture: seeded random observations (up to 20000 nodes) and six snapshots

negative.fixture: empty observation, unknown features, negation tails, selective vs unselective queries

versions.schema: vsf-observation-snapshot-v1, vsf-recognition-v1, vsf-evidence-ledger-v1, vsf-availability-v1 new; IR 1.0.0 unchanged

security_and_source_permissions: Reads structure and declared labels only; credential regions carry no text in the input.
performance_memory_storage: 20000 nodes: narrow query examines 1698 candidates vs 20000 for a scan; index 212165 B (10 B/node), 5755 sparse and 36 dense postings.
known_limitations: Feature set is fixed; new features need an index version bump
